cards.title: Optics moves from parts to systems
cards.question: Will customers pay for integrated optical assemblies, not just lasers?
cards.selfCheck: Integration can raise content per link; test qualified assemblies.
cards.prompt: FACT Sep 21: Coherent launched PhotonLink integrating lasers, silicon photonics, assembly and test for CPO/NPO. HYPOTHESIS: customers outsource difficult optical packaging, raising supplier content and switching costs. TEST: named production qualifications, assembly revenue and yield; copper/AEC and alternative integration remain threats. 7d: no verified new qualification; 30d: Nov 4 results; 90d: Sep 21 launch. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-launches-photonlinktm-integrated-optics-platform-ai https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results

cards.title: COHR sells the whole optical path
cards.question: Can Coherent capture more economics than a component-only vendor?
cards.selfCheck: Full assemblies may lift value; test datacenter mix and gross margin.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 4: Coherent fiscal Q1 revenue $2.37B (+50% reported y/y), GAAP GM 39.1%, non-GAAP GM 40.6%. FACT Sep 21 PhotonLink offers integrated optical assemblies. HYPOTHESIS: vertical integration yields higher value per AI link; no claim it is undiscovered. TEST: datacenter-specific organic growth, margins and capex returns; peer comparison MRVL, LITE. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-launches-photonlinktm-integrated-optics-platform-ai

cards.title: A purchase promise needs shipment proof
cards.question: When does NVIDIA's optical commitment become recurring COHR sales?
cards.selfCheck: March 2 commitment is real; verify product shipments and capacity.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL Mar 2 2026: NVIDIA-Coherent nonexclusive multiyear optical agreement includes multibillion-dollar purchase commitment and NVIDIA $2B investment; commitment is not recognized revenue. Jun 16 Sherman InP expansion announced, capacity quadrupling planned (not delivered). NEW PROOF Nov 4 Coherent $2.37B revenue and GM expansion, but no attribution of that growth to NVIDIA commitment. TEST 2027 capacity commissioning, qualification and product revenue; disconfirm delays, weaker yields or alternate sourcing. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nvidia-and-coherent-announce-strategic-partnership-develop https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-announces-chips-letter-intent-50-million-expand-world https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results

cards.title: Revenue growth is not free cash flow
cards.question: Will optical growth justify the manufacturing buildout?
cards.selfCheck: Revenue +50%; test cash conversion after fab spending.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 4 Coherent Q1 FY27 $2.37B revenue +50% y/y, GAAP GM 39.1%, non-GAAP GM 40.6%; Nov 4 outlook and filings needed to assess forward cash flow. HYPOTHESIS: integrated photonics boosts operating leverage but fab capex and customer concentration may absorb returns. Current market multiple and consensus revisions not independently verified; DO NOT assert mispricing. TEST: capex, operating cash flow, GAAP margin, working capital and return on new InP capacity. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-announces-chips-letter-intent-50-million-expand-world

cards.title: Wait for optical margin proof
cards.question: What evidence earns COHR a place on the investable shortlist?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH; require mix, yield and cash flow; reject margin erosion.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH framework, not trade instruction. Next 2-6 months: monitor Coherent fiscal Q2 FY27 results (date not verified), PhotonLink production orders, 6-inch InP capacity yield, gross margin and FCF. Compare enterprise value and forward earnings to organic growth when verified; no invented target price or consensus. Bull: assembly revenue scales faster than cost. Bear: capex, competition, customer concentration, yields or demand delay erase benefit. Compare MRVL merger thesis from Nov 16 against COHR standalone execution. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-launches-photonlinktm-integrated-optics-platform-ai https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-announces-chips-letter-intent-50-million-expand-world

cards.title: Find the hidden revenue bridge
cards.question: What turns an old customer promise into an early investment signal?
cards.selfCheck: Date commitment → capacity → shipment → margin; verify each step.
cards.prompt: Teach a reusable research method using COHR Mar 2 NVIDIA purchase commitment, Jun 16 planned Sherman fab expansion, Sep 21 PhotonLink launch, Nov 4 FY27 Q1 growth. None alone proves NVIDIA-derived revenue. Map contract -> qualification -> capacity -> shipments -> revenue recognition -> incremental margins -> free cash flow. Compare with yesterday's MRVL roadmap, distinguishing strategy from proof. Avoid momentum and hindsight bias. https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/nvidia-and-coherent-announce-strategic-partnership-develop https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-announces-chips-letter-intent-50-million-expand-world https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-launches-photonlinktm-integrated-optics-platform-ai https://coherent.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/coherent-corp-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-results
